display.name: Metrics
display.description:
OpenTelemetry metrics. 
Send metrics using the Prometheus OTLP endpoint activating `keep_identifying_resource_attributes` and resource attribute promotion (aka `promote_resource_attributes`) including `service.name`, service.namespace`, `service.instance.id`, and `deployment.environment.name`

display.name: Environment
display.description: Waiting to implement support of the optional value of `deployment.environment.name` in the OpenSearch and Jager panels, hide variable.

display.name: Latest metrics received
display.description: Shows the timestamp of the latest metrics received in the past 24h.

spec.query: timestamp(sum by (deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}) or absent{})

display.name: Duration
display.description:
HTTP & RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` & `rpc.server.duration` metrics.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration and https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/rpc/rpc-metrics/#metric-rpcserverduration

display.name: Error
display.description:
HTTP and RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` and `rpc.server.duration` metrics. 

Errors are identified by : 
* `http.response.status_code=~"5.."`
* `rpc.grpc.status_code!="0"`

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration

spec.query:
(
    (sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) * 100) 
    / 
    sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
or
(
    0
    * 
    sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

((sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name", rpc_grpc_status_code!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100) / sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
(0 * sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))

display.name: Request Rate
display.description:
HTTP & RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` & `rpc.server.duration` metrics.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration

spec.query: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])) by (deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name))

(sum(rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])) by (deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name)) * $__interval_ms / 1000

display.name: HTTP Operations
display.description:
Inbound HTTP operations of the service (aka HTTP endpoints) based on the `http.server.request.duration` metric.

Errors are identified by `http.response.status_code=~"5.."`.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration

spec.query:
sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )

(
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
    ) or (0 * 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
    )

histogram_quantile(
            0.99,
            sum by (le, operation) (
                label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[5m]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
                )
            )
        )

display.name: gRPC Operations
display.description:
Inbound gRPC operations of the service (aka gRPC endpoints) based on the `rpc.server.request.duration` metric.

Errors are identified by `rpc.grpc.status_code != 0` which make the panel specific to the gRPC protocol.

https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/rpc/rpc-metrics/#metric-rpcserverduration

spec.query:
sum by (operation) (
    label_join(
        rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
        "operation",
        "/",
        "rpc_service",
        "rpc_method"
    )
)

(
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name", rpc_grpc_status_code!="0"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                "/",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                "/",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"
            )
        )
    ) or (0 * 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "operation",
                "/",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"
            )
        )
    )

histogram_quantile(
            0.99,
            sum by (le, operation) (
                label_join(
                rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[5m]),
                "operation",
                "/",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"
                )
            )
        )

display.name: Outbound HTTP Services
display.description:
HTTP calls made by the service based on the `http.client.request.duration` metric.

Calls broken done by remote `server.address` and by `http.request.method`.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpclientrequestduration

spec.query:
sum by (outbound_service) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "outbound_service",
                " ",
                "server_address",
                "http_request_method",
                "url_template"
            )
        )

(
        sum by (outbound_service) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]),
                "outbound_service",
                " ",
                "server_address",
                "http_request_method",
                "url_template"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (outbound_service) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "outbound_service",
                " ",
                "server_address",
                "http_request_method",
                "url_template"
            )
        )
    ) or (0 * 
        sum by (outbound_service) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "outbound_service",
                " ",
                "server_address",
                "http_request_method",
                "url_template"
            )
        )
    )

histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by (le, outbound_service) (
        label_join(
        rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[5m]),
        "outbound_service",
        " ",
        "server_address",
        "http_request_method",
        "url_template"
        )
    )
)

                "outbound_service",
                "/",
                "server_address",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (outbound_service) (
            label_join(
                rate(rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~"$deployment_environment_name", service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "outbound_service",
                "/",
                "server_address",

                "outbound_service",
                "/",
                "server_address",
                "rpc_service",
                "rpc_method"

histogram_quantile(

        "/",
        "server_address",
        "rpc_service",
        "rpc_method"
        )
    )
)

display.description:
Logs of the service, filtered by `service.name`, `service.namespace`, and `deployment.environment.name`.

To explore the logs, open the menu clicking on the icon `⋮` of this panel and click on `Explore`.

spec.query: search source=otel-logs-* | where resource.service.name="$service_name" and resource.service.namespace="$service_namespace" | fields @timestamp, severity.text, body, instrumentationScope.name
